content: {"episode_id":"ep-05122","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with a history of atherosclerotic heart disease and reports intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by dizziness and giddiness. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease, as documented in the clinical indication note. This service directly supports the diagnosis codes I25.10, R00.2, and R42, and is medically necessary to evaluate the symptomatic presentation in a patient with established coronary artery disease."}
